nodes.description: Hardcoded developer/CEO address that receives commissions and attack/defense payments.
Array of Planet structs storing name, owner, price and accumulated resources.
Mapping of address to number of planets owned, used in purchase and steal checks.
Mapping of address to purchased attack power.
Mapping of address to purchased defense power.
Fixed price payable to purchase one attack point.
Fixed price payable to purchase one defense point.
Mutable nonce mixed into keccak256 randomness generation.
Flag preventing re-initialization of the planet list.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal ceoAddress; used as access control gate.
Payable function that buys a planet, pays the previous owner 95% and the CEO 5%, then raises the price by 50%.
Payable function that transfers msg.value to the CEO and increments the caller's attack count.
Payable function that transfers msg.value to the CEO and increments the caller's defense count.
Function that computes a pseudo-random stealed amount from a target planet and transfers it to the caller.
Read-only view returning a user's planet, attack and defense counts.
Read-only view returning planet data plus the owner's attack and defense counts.
CEO-only function pushing a new Planet struct into the planets array.
CEO-only function that creates the initial set of planets exactly once.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, payment and receiving ETH.
Block timestamp (now) used as entropy source in the random number generation.
External .transfer of the 95% sale commission to planets[_planetId].ownerAddress in purchasePlanet.
External .transfer of the 5% commission to ceoAddress in purchasePlanet.
External .transfer of msg.value to ceoAddress in purchaseAttack.
External .transfer of msg.value to ceoAddress in purchaseDefense.
External .transfer of resourcesStealable to msg.sender in StealResources, performed before state update.
Pseudo-random generation via keccak256(now, msg.sender, randNonce) % 49, predictable by miners/callers.
Unchecked uint256 arithmetic in purchasePlanet: price increase, resource addition and ownership count decrement.
Unchecked uint256 arithmetic in StealResources: resourcesStealable calculation and resource subtraction.
Parameter selecting which planet to purchase in purchasePlanet.
Parameter selecting which planet to attack in StealResources.
Parameter of getUserDetails identifying the queried address.
Parameter of getPlanet identifying the queried planet.
Parameter of createPlanet holding the new planet name.
Parameter of createPlanet holding the initial price.
Local variable holding the 5% commission in purchasePlanet.
Local variable holding the 95% payout to the previous owner.
Local pseudo-random value (1..49) computed in StealResources.
Local amount of resources computed and transferred in StealResources.
Local index returned by planets.push in createPlanet.
Storage pointer to a Planet struct in getPlanet.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer in StealResources, enabling reentrancy.
msg.sender drives the ownership and attack-power checks in StealResources.
msg.sender becomes the new owner in purchasePlanet.
block.timestamp (now) is used as entropy in the random number generation.
The generated random value determines the transferred amount in StealResources.
resourcesStealable is the ETH amount sent to msg.sender before state update.
_planetId selects the planet whose resources are transferred out.
StealResources executes the external transfer to the caller.
The external transfer can re-enter StealResources before curResources is decremented.
StealResources generates the pseudo-random value from block data.
_planetId indexes the planet attacked in StealResources.
purchasePlanet performs the 95% payout transfer to the previous owner.
purchasePlanet performs the 5% commission transfer to the CEO.
commission5percent is the amount transferred to the CEO.
commissionOwner is the amount transferred to the previous owner.
_planetId selects the planet purchased.
purchaseAttack forwards msg.value to the CEO.
purchaseDefense forwards msg.value to the CEO.
onlyCeo restricts createPlanet to the CEO address.
ceoAddress is the reference compared against msg.sender in onlyCeo.
InitiatePlanets calls createPlanet for each initial planet.
createPlanet pushes a new Planet into the planets array.
_planetPrice sets the initial curPrice of the new planet.
_planetName sets the name of the new planet.
planetId holds the index produced by planets.push.
_user selects the address queried in getUserDetails.
_planetId selects the planet queried in getPlanet.
_planet storage pointer reads fields returned by getPlanet.
addressAttackCount is compared against the defender in StealResources.
addressDefenseCount of the owner is used in the StealResources check.
addressPlanetsCount is required to be positive before stealing.
planets supplies owner and resources data used in StealResources.
attackCost is validated against msg.value in purchaseAttack.
defenseCost is validated against msg.value in purchaseDefense.
randNonce is mixed into the keccak256 randomness.
randNonce is incremented after random generation.
purchasePlanet performs unchecked uint256 price, resource and count arithmetic.
The arithmetic results update planet price/resources state.
StealResources performs unchecked multiplication and subtraction on resources.
The arithmetic result rewrites planets[_planetId].curResources.
StealResources reads the defender's defense count for comparison.
StealResources reads the attacker's attack count for comparison.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only indexes the planet handled by purchasePlanet.
Parameter only selects the target planet inside StealResources.
Parameter is only used as the mapping key inside getUserDetails.
Parameter is only used to index the planets array in getPlanet.
Parameter is only written into the new Planet struct in createPlanet.
Parameter is only used as the initial price in createPlanet.
Temporary 95% payout value local to purchasePlanet.
Local random value produced by the RNG unsafe operation in StealResources.
Local amount directly consumed by the external transfer unsafe operation.
Temporary index from planets.push in createPlanet.
Storage pointer local to the getPlanet read logic.
